blocker: The repo ELEVENLABS_API_KEY lacks the `sound_generation` permission (returns 401); every sound in apps/web/public/audio/manifest.json is source="synth" (offline DSP fallback). A town crier's shout is a HUMAN VOICE cue, which is (a) out of scope for Meshy and (b) explicitly excluded from the offline DSP kit in gen_ambient_audio.mjs ("no voices anywhere"). Faking it with the noise-based synth would violate the quality bar, so it is intentionally left unbuilt.
unblock: Grant the ElevenLabs key `sound_generation` (or use a voice/TTS product), then add the spec below to the SOUNDS array in assets/pipeline/gen_ambient_audio.mjs and run: node assets/pipeline/gen_ambient_audio.mjs --force  (writes apps/web/public/audio/crier-shout.mp3 + manifest.json)
Alternatively author it in the localhost text-slice / voiced-line pass as a short recorded/TTS VO line rather than an ambient SFX.

dropInSpec.name: crier-shout
dropInSpec.prompt: a single male 18th century town crier shouting an announcement outdoors on a colonial street, strong projected 'Hear ye!' style call, no music, no crowd, natural outdoor reverb, close mic
dropInSpec.note: 3 call-spots along the central street (x -8, 6, 24); one shout pulse per spot. Subtitle carried by the runtime, not the audio.

existingReusable: dog-bark.wav already exists for FLV-dog audio (separate from the street-dog GLB); no new dog audio needed.
